event_description: User changed the story type filter (Top, Best, Ask, Show) on the home screen.
User navigated to a story's discussion/detail page from the feed.
User opened a story's external article URL from the feed.
User tapped the upvote button on a story in the feed.
User viewed a story's full detail page (top of engagement funnel).
User opened a story's external URL from the story detail page.
User tapped the upvote button from within a story's detail page.
User tapped the story author's name to view their HN profile.
User navigated to the parent story from a comment detail view.
User opened a comment's nested replies/sub-thread.
User tapped a comment author's name to view their HN profile.
User viewed a Hacker News user's profile page.
